trails.title: The Games Go On
trails.description: No matter what comes after, these unprecedented qualifiers have already left a lasting impression on everyone.

content.text:
Note: This list has undergone a second review.

Winged Key Archery

[Confirmed] - Peter Thomas (Kent) (Note: Event participants confirmed to be fewer than three. Permitted to continue as per regulations).

[Withdrew] - Victoria White (Yorkshire) (Note: Found 12 days after having gone lost her direction in the smog during a London training session. Exhibits a severe screaming reaction to Winged Keys. Withdrew for safety reasons).

[Withdrew] - Stanley Smith (London) (Note: Unable to make contact. Recorded as withdrawn). (Note: Found on the Paris qualifiers' final participant list. Verified as the same individual).

......

1500m Weighted Run (15 kg Division)

[Withdrew] - Bluebell Dove (Kent) (Note: Both entered and withdrew under an alias).

[Withdrew][Confirmed] - Charles Scott (Gwynedd) (Note: Originally in the 25 kg division. After withdrawing, re-registered for 15 kg division after low participation count was observed).

[Confirmed] - Lily Morris (Glasgow) (Note: Honorary Scottish Shetland Pony Club member. Decided to continue competing after failing to transport her pony out of London in the middle of this fog).

...

Floor Ritual 

[Confirmed] - Caroline Bartley (South Yorkshire) (Note: Qualified directly for the Uluru finals).

[Withdrew][Confirmed] - Anna Baldwin (Essex) (Note: Initially withdrew due to Caroline Bartley's entry. Rejoined after learning Bartley already qualified for finals).

[Confirmed] - Willow (London) (Note: Registered under an alias).

...

items.text: Uncle Bill, Aunt Connie, Little Mary, Old Harold ...
The people of Cross Street stand gathered at the front of the stage, hammers and saws in their hands. Old Harold discreetly moves a shovel out of sight.
Perched on a tree, a canary nervously swivels its head to watch the crowd assembled on this bleak winter day.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Leave it to me, darl.
Tooth Fairy gives a slight nod, and Brimley ascends the makeshift wooden podium.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Testing. Testing.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Ladies and gentlemen, your attention, please! Today marks the beginning of the London Uluru Exhibition Games.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: As you can see, the weather isn't looking great. The smog still sits heavy in the sky.
The crowd beneath the platform looks up at Brimley, cement stains and coal smudges on their faces.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: There's no wind, no sunshine, no warmth, and even my brim is soggy from the damp. It's truly miserable out here.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: On top of that, the stadium's shabby, and we only have a limited number of athletes.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: To many, these games would be seen as disappointing.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: However, even without the support of the Foundation, we've managed to rebuild this stadium with nothing but our own hands and determination!

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: I've confirmed that our stadium meets all the standards required by the government, and there's no doubt that it matches the Foundation's, too!

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: As for the operation of our Games, we've built a reliable team consisting of various Uluru professionals and supporters.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: They are currently in every corner of the stadium, working their hardest to prepare for the upcoming event.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: They will be our backbone, supporting the entire Games to ensure that everything runs smoothly.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: As we all come together, I believe the passion of our Games will burn as hot as the sacred fire of Uluru itself!

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: So, without further ado, I hereby declare ...

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: That the London Uluru Exhibition Games have begun!
The crowd bustles and chatters like a flock of birds.
Tooth Fairy, Brimley, and Flutterpage are quickly bombarded by a flood of questions.

items.speaker: Judge I
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy! We don't have enough judges for the Winged Key Archery! Frantz has been put on to umpire two events at the same time, so he left to do the other one!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Two events at the same time?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: The other event starts tomorrow. He must've mixed up the schedule. Get him to come back.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: All athletes participating in the 1500-Meter Weighted Run, please report to the third preparation area. I repeat, please report to the third preparation area.

items.speaker: Player I
items.text: Umm. Excuse me. I-I lost my name tag. Can I get a new one?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Certainly. Go straight ahead, and take the first left to get to the player office. There's a girl called Flutterpage in there. Show her your ID, and she'll give you a new tag.

items.speaker: Judge II
items.text: I'll take you there. Follow me, friend.

items.speaker: Player I
items.text: Sure. Thanks.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Oi, hold on a minute. "Friend," why haven't I seen you before?
Brimley examines the judge suspiciously before pulling his ID card directly from the inside of his coat.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: This ID is fake. Security!

items.speaker: Judge II
items.text: I-I'm just a big fan. Please, don't kick me out! I just—
The volunteer security team quickly swoops in and removes the impersonator.
One of them whispers a few words to Brimley.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Tooth Fairy, my darl.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: What is it, Head of Security?

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: I've been told that a mate of ours would like to post some fliers in the stadium.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: We already have a sponsor. I'm afraid you'll have to turn him down.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: By mate, I mean Arthur.
Tooth Fairy glances over to where Brimley is looking and catches sight of a black-and-white banner at the entrance to the venue.
Smog Kills.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Has he been sitting all this time under that banner with his machine?

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Yeah. He's using it to show everyone what could happen if they breathe in too much smog.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I don't know if I should call him wavering in his principles or completely stubborn in them.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Arthur's always been a righteous official. He truly cares about the people. He's tough, tenacious, and has a powerful ability to influence others.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You sound more like an official than he does.
Tooth Fairy looks over at the athletes preparing to race and the crowd cheering them on enthusiastically.

items.speaker: Spectator I
items.text: Come on! Go for it!

items.speaker: Spectator II
items.text: First place! Yes!

items.speaker: Spectator III
items.text: Waahhh ... No ...

items.speaker: Player II
items.text: Thank you! Thank you!
The athlete blows kisses at the spectators, triggering another wave of excitement.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Not even the smog can stop the people's enthusiasm for sports. No matter the obstacle, they will always find a way to enjoy it.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I suppose Mr. Fog is still refusing to take one of Flutterpage's sheets?

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Of course, he is. Arthur said he'd never run away from the smog. As Fogwalker, he has to "confront" it.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: He's stubborn, just as you said.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: Floor Ritual competitors, please report to the fifth preparation area. I repeat, please report to the fifth preparation area.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Oh! That's Ms. O'Hagan's event.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Yeah.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Do you think she'll show up?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy, Mr. Brimley, did you hear that? The Floor Ritual's about to start!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: But where's Ms. Willow?
Tooth Fairy looks at Brimley. Though he has no eyes for her to read, the slight shifting of his brim carries a sense of trepidation.
Neither knows how to respond to the child, hesitating between igniting her hopes and destroying her dreams.
Or perhaps the truth is exactly what she's hoping for?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Go check the Floor Ritual venue, Flutterpage.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: What for? Is Ms. Willow there?
She looks directly at Tooth Fairy. Her eyes widen as they begin to sparkle.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: She's there, isn't she?!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You'll have to go there to find out.
She can't help but give a slight smile.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: I'll cover for you at the player office. Just go, little tacker.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Go on, then.
Flutterpage starts to smile, but a flicker of doubt quickly clouds her expression.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: This time, I won't disappoint her.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I've brought her a real game. No need to climb the tower and hide away anymore. This is real.
She raises her hand and waves to Tooth Fairy and Brimley, a determined look on her face.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: See you later!
With that, Flutterpage turns and runs off.
The Fifth Preparation Area
At the fifth preparation area, the Floor Ritual competitors are warming up.

items.speaker: Player No. 2401
items.text: Look at this place. You could find a better venue at any school in the city. These Games are really something.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: They built it in a matter of days. We can't ask for much.

items.speaker: Player No. 2401
items.text: Oh my! It's an honor to meet you, Ms. Bartley.
The competitor hurriedly wipes her hands before extending one to Caroline.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Take care warming up. You wouldn't want to get hurt just before the competition.

items.speaker: Player No. 2401
items.text: You're very kind. Thank you.
A staff member with a volunteer ID strides in from the doorway.

items.speaker: Volunteer I
items.text: Floor Ritual competitors, the event will start in one minute. Please confirm your numbers, as I will be calling you to enter the floor in numerical order.

items.speaker: Volunteer I
items.text: Competitor No. 2401, please enter the floor. Competitors 2402 and 2403, please wait in the locker room.

items.speaker: Player No. 2402
items.text: Good luck!
The first competitor receives a few well-wishes before waving goodbye as she makes her way to the competition floor.
Now that the event has begun, Caroline stops warming up.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Hmm. What about Charlotte?

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: *deep breath*

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Charlotte, you're here. I knew you wouldn't be able to stay away. You haven't changed a bit.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Hmm?
Willow pauses in the middle of her stretch.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: What do you want from me?

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: What do I want? Have you forgotten about the challenge?

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: What's your number?

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: I don't think that's any of your concern, or are you trying to win over the organizers with a little goody-two-shoes act? The ever-so-helpful competitor-turned-volunteer, Ms. Bartley?

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Oh, I didn't know you could be so sarcastic.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: You better get used to it.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Really? You mean we'll chat again in the future?
Willow turns her head away from her.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: I'm not the Charlotte you used to know. Stop trying to bond with me.
Caroline walks toward her.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: But you are the Charlotte I used to know.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: You're still that black swan I've always chased after. When I saw your performance, the grace, the beauty of it, it inspired me to become a Floor Ritualist. But you just disappeared after you became champion.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Well, as long as you're back ... Heh heh.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: What's so funny?
Caroline looks at Willow with a quiet composure, her lips forming a slight smile.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: See you on the floor.
Caroline heads back to the preparation area.

items.speaker: Volunteer I
items.text: Player No. 2406, Caroline Bartley, please enter the floor.
The sound of the volunteer's voice filters into the room, muffled and distorted by the walls.
Willow stamps her slightly stiff right leg.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Time for me to head in, too.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Excuse me.
She finds her way to the spectator seats, settling into a corner.
Caroline gracefully strides onto the floor, pausing to give a gentle bow to the judges. Then, she brushes her hand across the didgeriwood, and positions herself in the center, ready to begin.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: Player No. 2406, Caroline Bartley, whenever you're ready.
Caroline starts to dance. Receiving her channeled energy, the didgeriwood produces a rich, resonant sound.
